propositions: A plan edited mid-review incurs waste: all LLM passes after the edit run to completion only to fail at sign time when fresh own_material differs from initial_generation.own_material
Pass-1 checkpoints keyed by material fingerprint are invalidated by mid-run edits, making completed chunks unreusable
The cancel predicate must scope to own material only (excluding relation_snapshot and ticket_store_revision) to avoid false cancels from unrelated ticket writes (regression d70a)

The cancellation signal must be checked before coach/verify recovery paths in gate_dispatch to prevent a failed step from being recovered into a findings verdict that would trigger signing and sidecar emission

Two seam probes (after finders and after decide) detect own-material staleness without store-wide reads or sync-lock acquisition by calling attest.current_material_fingerprint under local_read_context
An out-of-band token (ContextVar holding _CancelScope with threading.Event) allows the cancel state to propagate to pooled _chunk workers via copy_context without per-chunk polling
